item.title: $10 million project adds housing, shops to Solvay
item.description: A $10 million development project in the Village of Solvay, supported by state and county funding, will bring 33 new apartments and storefronts to the community's main street, providing housing and economic opportunities in anticipation of the nearby Micron Technology semiconductor manufacturing plant.

item.title: Syracuse hospital gets breastfeeding designation, first in Onondaga County
item.description: SYRACUSE, N.Y. (WSYR-TV) -- A Syracuse hospital has become the first Onondaga County medical practice to receive a state honor for breastfeeding programs. The OB-GYN practice at St. Joseph’s Physicians Primary Care Center practice received the New York State Breastfeeding, Chestfeeding, and Lactation Friendly Practice Designation, a news release from the center said Wednesday. item.title: Onondaga Republicans urge repeal of NY climate law
item.description: Onondaga County's Republican legislators have launched an online petition to repeal New York's Climate Leadership and Community Protection Act, citing rising utility costs for Central New Yorkers.
